description.value: On The Go Gelato is an indoor gelato and ice cream shop in Tsawwassen, BC, tagged as wheelchair accessible in OpenStreetMap. It appears to be a small artisan-style gelato outlet — the kind of sweet stop a touring cyclist might seek out after a ride along the South Delta routes or before or after a BC Ferries sailing from the nearby Tsawwassen terminal.
